 Yordan Alvarez Wins 2026 MLB Outstanding DH Award Awards, Ends Shohei Ohtani's Historic Streak
 Zach Bachar Nov 11, 2026 Houston Astros star Yordan Alvarez won the 2026 Edgar Martínez Outstanding Designated Hitter Award on Wednesday night.
 Alvarez became the first Astros player to ever receive the honor.
